The '''zeeda''' was a [[Knife/Legends|throwing knife]]. The [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Arcuse]] carried a zeeda throwing knife and was proficient in its use.
